name: Bowl with Underfired Black Glaze
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably late 11th-early 12th century；Underfired Black Ding ware: porcelaneous white stoneware with brownish green, tea-dust-like glaze. Probably from the kilns at Jianci village, possibly from those at East or West Yanchuan village, Quyang county, Hebei province.
